description: Renders a pairwise alignment as three-line blocks in the EMBOSS needle/water (srspair) style: the markup line has '|' for identical columns, ':' for similar columns (positive substitution score), '.' for mismatches and ' ' for gap columns; wrapped to a configurable line width. matrix (BLOSUM62 | PAM250 | EDNAFULL) or the scalar match/mismatch decide which mismatches are similar.

lineWidth.description: Maximum characters per line in the formatted output (>= 1).

matrix.description: Optional substitution matrix deciding which non-gap columns are similar: any built-in matrix by EMBOSS or NCBI name (BLOSUM62, PAM250, EBLOSUM45, EPAM120, EDNAFULL, ...). Omit to use match/mismatch.

match.description: Scalar model (used when matrix is omitted): score of an identical pair.

mismatch.description: Scalar model (used when matrix is omitted): score of a non-identical pair; > 0 marks mismatches ':' (similar).

errors.message: Aligned sequence cannot be null or empty
